{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Filter for converted customers
converted_customers = df[df['converted'] == 1]

# Exclude those with missing age (age == -1)
valid_converted = converted_customers[converted_customers['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute mean age
mean_age_converted = valid_converted['customer_age'].mean()

# Compute the number of valid converted customers
n_valid_converted = len(valid_converted)

# Print all required numbers
print(f"Mean age of converted customers (excluding -1): {mean_age_converted}")
print(f"Number of converted customers with valid age: {n_valid_converted}")
print(f"Number of converted customers with age -1: {len(converted_customers) - n_valid_converted}")

# Return for submission
mean_age_converted"}
